name: card
title: Card
description: Holds one piece of content, built from parts you put together as you need.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding of 16, 20 or 28 pixels, with type and gaps to match.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card a link. Use it only when the card holds no other buttons or links.

parts.name: Card
parts.description: The card itself. Renders a link when you pass href.

parts.name: CardMedia
parts.description: A picture at the top, edge to edge. Pass src and alt, or your own children.

parts.name: CardDescription
parts.description: A line or two under the title.

parts.name: CardContent
parts.description: Anything else: a list, a form, a chart.

parts.name: CardFooter
parts.description: A row at the bottom for actions or details.
